claim: Scratch byte $0A01 of the mine main chamber is a hit counter: each of the four dm3F_switch placements zeroes it at spawn and adds 1 per hit, and dm3F_mine_collapse_trigger fires when it equals 4 (BG change #21, rumble #0E, word flag $0121).

trial.control: load scene $3F, hit one switch four times with a Psycho Dash and read byte $0A01 after every hit
trial.forced: hit four different switches once each, then hit a fifth time; also write $0A01 := 3 and hit once
observe: BG tilemap of the tunnel entrance (screenshot)

confirms: the collapse fires on the hit that makes $0A01 equal 4, regardless of which switches were hit
refutes: the collapse needs four different switches, or never fires after a fifth hit has passed 4 without the check
